result.stdout:
Description:
  Synchronize Git repositories, including their .git folders, with the RepoDrive folder in OneDrive.

Usage:
  repodrive [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
  --version       Show version information

Commands:
  login             Sign in with a personal Microsoft account.
  logout            Sign out and remove cached tokens.
  whoami            Show the signed-in account and its RepoDrive app folder.
  config            Show or change settings.
  list              List repositories under the projects root and projects stored in OneDrive.
  status <project>  Compare a repository with OneDrive without changing anything.
  push <projects>   Upload repositories to OneDrive.
  pull <projects>   Download repositories from OneDrive.

result.stdout:
Description:
  Upload repositories to OneDrive.

Usage:
  repodrive push [<projects>...] [options]

Arguments:
  <projects>  Project folder names under the projects root.

Options:
  --all           Push every Git repository under the projects root.
  --dry-run       Show the plan without changing anything.
  --force         Make OneDrive match the local repository even when OneDrive has changes that would be lost.
  -y, --yes       Do not ask for confirmation before deleting.
  --verify        Recompute local hashes instead of trusting the size and modification time cache.
  -v, --verbose   List every planned and completed operation.
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
